description: MATSim Open Kelheim provides a calibrated MATSim model developed in the KelRide project. The provider is TU Berlin. Geographical and temporal coverage: The scenario represents a 25 percent population sample of Kelheim and surrounding areas, Germany, with scaled road capacities. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is GPL-2.0 for program code; data licences may differ. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-matsim, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
